About

About me

Hi, I'm Keerthiga, a UI/UX and product designer at Octech Digital in Bengaluru. I studied Computer Science at VIT, then moved from code to design because I cared most about the people using the product.

Over the past 2+ years I've designed loyalty platforms, retailer products, gaming apps across 10+ apps & web products, plus 100+ campaigns for 20+ leading consumer brands like ITC, KitKat, Philips and Britannia. My coding background helps me design things engineers can actually build.
